ticket.subject: Subject access request
ticket.body_text:
Dear support,

I would like to exercise my right to access and receive a copy of the personal data your company holds about me.

I used your app through my former employer, Tidewell Logistics. For verification, my SSN is 987-65-4320. Please copy my colleague at maria.lopez@ottervale.example.com on your reply.

We would like this sorted before the end of the week. Please confirm receipt and the expected timeline.

Kind regards,
Priya Esposito
